question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Trivial
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Trivial"** means something that is of little value or importance. (तुच्छ)

 
 
• **Example: **She often gets upset over trivial matters.
 
 
 
• **"Essential" **refers to something that is absolutely necessary or extremely important. (आवश्यक)
 
 
• **Example: **Water is essential for all forms of life.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Trivial' **is **'Essential'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lavish **(शानदार): Rich, elaborate, or luxurious.

 
 
• **Example:** They threw a lavish party for their anniversary.
 
 
 
• **Vain **(अभिमानी): Having or showing an excessively high opinion of one's appearance, abilities, or worth.
 
 
• **Example: **He is so vain that he checks his reflection in every mirror he passes.
 
 
 
• **Liable** (उत्तरदायी): Responsible by law; legally answerable.
 
 
• **Example:** The company is liable for any damages caused by their product.
